== Sha'rah ==

Hi Robin,

Yeah, the board in the picture has 15 by 15, but am not sure why as the board is described as 13 by 13 in the chapter: "His real attention was on the game laid out before him on the table, thirty-three red pieces and thirty-three green arrayed across a playing surface of thirteen squares by thirteen." The 33 red and 33 green pieces line up in three rows of 11 on each side very neatly on the part of the board that is not a goal row if it is 13 by 13 too, but if it's 15 by 15 then the pieces have to be arranged differently in a way that doesn't seem logical. Otherwise, why 33? [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 04:03, 23 January 2021 (UTC)

: I think I may have discussed this with Linda from 13th Depository on WoTmania at some point and we disagreed. The WoTmania FAQ had the image below included, but Linda has a 15 by 15 board. I think she interpreted it incorrectly and possibly that was copied by whoever made the board. On consultation, the Companion entry says the game is "played on a board that is 13 by 13 squares" and not 15 by 15 which seems a much simpler explanation and confirms my own interpretation. [[File:Sha'rah board.jpg|thumb]]
There is a following excerpt on 13th depository from the same chapter: "The green-and-red goal-row that surrounded the playing surface could be threatened by any piece, but only the Fisher could move onto it." so surrounding tiles make for 14th and 15th row.
:: Linda made that interpretation herself. To say that the goal row isn't part of the "playing surface" seems to be splitting hairs. It's certainly used during the game if the Fisher can be moved on and off it, so what else is it part of if not the playing surface? If I were describing a plate I could say it was "surrounded by a red rim" and that doesn't mean the rim isn't part of the plate. Besides, the Companion says straight out that it's on a 13 by 13 board, and that's taken from Jordan's notes. What do you think of the three rows of 11 counters on each side if it's on a 15 by 15 board? It seems a much simpler explanation to use 13 by 13, no? [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 23:52, 25 January 2021 (UTC)
With such argument, you may really be right [[User:Robin WH|Robin WH]] ([[User talk:Robin WH|talk]]) 03:39, 26 January 2021 (UTC)
